correctness.rationale: The descendant subtree vectors S_i form a unitriangular basis. Black rows equal -S_i; modulo their span a white row is the sum of S_c for its white children. These sets are disjoint for distinct white parents, so rank counts all black vertices plus white vertices with white children. Labeled species of colored rooted trees give B/W EGFs and the full rank polynomial. In a uniform Prüfer tree, degree(i)=1+Bin(n-1,1/(n+1)), and conditional white leaf probability 2^{-deg(i)} yields exact mean. Pairwise covariance is O(1/n) because Prüfer counts are multinomial and adjacency probability 2/(n+1), yielding Var(D)=O(n), L² limit. Independent full colored-tree enumeration matches polynomial coefficients and exact mean for all n=1..5; this is finite corroboration.
residual_risks: The finite computations alone do not establish unrestricted hypotheses, parameter domains or infinite quantifiers; proof reconstruction supplies those steps.
